text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! ...Kh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... Brian-san is so fast... 
aaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Why?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why... can't I do it yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez. It kinda feels like Maya isn't 
even on your radar.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Brian... where are you even 
looking...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Where is Brian-san looking, I 
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan, you know what? I have a 
favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Just one more time, as soon as possible... 
I want to race against Brian-san.
choice_data_list: So you plan on challenging it again, huh.

So you plan on challenging it again, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it has to be. ...I don't really know 
why, though.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, for some reason, I just felt like 
I had to hurry this time...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
! Mayano... Is that what this race made 
you realize?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then all the more reason I 
can't just leave you like this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —The Arima Kinen will surely be her last.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's planning to make the Arima her 
'last' race, and hang up her running shoes 
after that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Tch... It's way too early for the curtain 
call...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Why? That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way it's over... I mean, 
Brian-san was so strong today too."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You went and got Maya all thrilled again, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And yet, to think it's over already. No... 
I don't want to accept that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya hates constantly losing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...And this time for sure, Maya isn't 
just gonna get excited— Maya's gonna make 
him feel thrilled too!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling Umamusume can excite the hearts 
of everyone— both the rivals running 
beside them and the spectators watching.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Then Maya wants to be someone who can 
make that person thrilled too...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-chan. You know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Hishi Ama-san, you 
said the Arima Kinen would be Brian-san's 
last, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to get Maya into 
perfect shape by the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks. Ehehe, I'm counting on you.

—If we aim for the Arima Kinen while 
arranging a GI rotation full of the strong 
rivals she seeks...

"At least once in the summer, and once in 
the autumn. You should enter mid-to-long 
or medium distance GⅠ races that prepare 
you for the Arima."
choice_data_list:
The Takarazuka Kinen, the Autumn Tenno 
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then Maya will enter that one. 
I'll run in races... and get stronger at 
top speed.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Because I feel like... that's what I have 
to do.
